model: HD2 Protocol Series duct humidity / temperature sensor
aliases: Plant Room Humidity and Temperature Unit
applies_to: Veris HD2 Protocol Series duct and plant-room humidity/temperature sensors (and the Schneider SpaceLogic SHD2 twin) set to BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The HD2 Protocol Series is a duct or plant-room humidity and temperature sensor with an RS-485 port for BACnet MS/TP or Modbus. Its BACnet list is three objects: temperature, humidity and a display-units switch for LCD models. It shares object names with the HW2 wall sensor but has none of the HW2 touchscreen objects.
notes: The objects table has no access column; BV 4 is marked writable from its description.
BV 4 is kept through power outages and applies to LCD models only (as printed).
Schneider SpaceLogic SHD2 Series (guide GEX55243) prints the same table.

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP address and protocol, then read AI 1 and AI 2.
setup: Device instance defaults to Vendor ID followed by the MS/TP address; Object_Identifier is writable.

note: Provided as-is. Point availability varies by firmware and options; verify against the live device.
